pos.personaBrief: Carille's Corinthians prioritised defensive safety but held the ball when sitting back (2017-08 DOL) and wanted a technical midfield with possession (2017-11); they also countered quickly (2018-04).

pro.personaBrief: Short passing 'de pé em pé' and triangulations (2018-04, 2017-08) plus holding the ball after recovery point to patient build-up, with safety first; Jô as a target man keeps a direct option.

est.personaBrief: A well-organised 4-2-3-1/4-1-4-1 with defined roles and a fixed centre-forward (Jô) points to positional structure; the false nine arrived only in 2018.

lar.personaBrief: Two wide players 'caindo pelas laterais' and a centre-forward finisher (Tribuna PR 2018, Lance 2018) plus his wish for 'dois de lado' make the team wide-oriented, though he also wanted a central four.

blo.personaBrief: Compact, defence-first block, 'fechar o funil' and few gaps between lines (AP 2017); pressing only fragments, such as marking São Paulo's build-up and a more advanced line in 2018.

mar.personaBrief: No source on marking type; compact collective defence and positional work on aerial balls suggest zonal tendencies, with no sign of dedicated man-marking.

pla.personaBrief: Pragmatic and adaptive: changed system to a false nine in 2018, set up specifically to press São Paulo's build-up, and shaped play around available players, though with a stable defensive core.

res.personaBrief: Said he always prioritised defensive security over attacking flair (2017-06) and that stages come first with defensive consistency; though he attacked even when a draw was enough (2017-04).

sis.personaBrief: Collective organisation turned Jô and Rodriguinho around and made a squad of modest means champion; roles apply to everyone, no star freedom emphasised.

jog.personaBrief: Wanted a more technical midfield with possession and conduction (2017-11), but was also concerned with aerial defence and relied on solid physical defenders.

bas.personaBrief: Said he wanted more space for youngsters (2017-01), but the title team relied on experienced players and economical signings; realist about finances.

lid.personaBrief: Group-focused, 'grupo maravilhoso que compra a ideia', simple and humble, yet boss of a clear organised system; limited evidence on discipline.
